ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1794734656000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.
